{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales_df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Convert 'revenue' to float
sales_df['revenue'] = pd.to_numeric(sales_df['revenue'], errors='coerce')

# Verify premises
channels_present = set(sales_df['channel'].unique())
expected_channels = {'email', 'paid_search'}
channels_match = channels_present == expected_channels

converted_is_binary = set(sales_df['converted'].unique()) == {0, 1}

# Check for confounding: cross-tabulate channel with other variables
print("Cross-tabulation: channel vs customer_segment")
print(pd.crosstab(sales_df['channel'], sales_df['customer_segment']))

print("\nCross-tabulation: channel vs customer_age (binned into decades)")
age_bins = pd.cut(sales_df['customer_age'], bins=[0, 29, 39, 49, 59, 100], labels=['20s', '30s', '40s', '50s', '60s+'])
print(pd.crosstab(sales_df['channel'], age_bins))

print("\nCross-tabulation: channel vs status")
print(pd.crosstab(sales_df['channel'], sales_df['status']))

# Compute conversion rates
conversion_rates = sales_df.groupby('channel')['converted'].mean()
c_email = conversion_rates['email']
c_paid_search = conversion_rates['paid_search']
difference = c_email - c_paid_search

# Print results
print(f"\nConversion rate - email: {c_email}")
print(f"Conversion rate - paid_search: {c_paid_search}")
print(f"Difference (email - paid_search): {difference}")"}
